title: Python console: ordered output and honest interactive input
summary: Improve the existing isolated Python Studio runtime and console without replacing navigation, files, exercises or the AI teacher.

changes.detail: Preserve stdout/stderr execution order, bound event delivery, echo actual input answers, remove invented default answers and silent unsupported-input fallback.
Show explicit completion/failure/cancellation, deterministic error help, Explain Error and copy suggestion actions, separate raw streams, and scroll-follow behavior that respects manual reading.
ImportError and cautious unknown-exception guidance, retaining actual learner traceback locations.

validation.name: Implementation verification
validation.detail: Needs unit, real-runtime, browser, mobile bundle and Android checks. iOS device coverage and fixed per-worker memory quotas are not available; runtime requires pinned CDN access.
